name: luhede2024_weser
citation: Luhede A, Yaqine H, Bahmanbijari R, Roemer M, Upmann T (2024) The value of information in water quality monitoring and management. Ecological Economics 219:108128
retrieved: 2026-11-23, publisher PDF from the institutional repository epic.awi.de (eprint 59378)
decision: Whether to take a management action on a water body of the Weser whose ecological state (good or bad) is uncertain
unit: payoff in millions of euros per year (the paper's valuation: 200 for a water body in the good state, action cost 90)

action_names.a1: management action (always reaches or keeps the good state)

table2.provenance: Table 2 of the article, payoff v(a, x): rows = actions, columns = states x0 (bad), x1 (good)

targets.where: Section 4, Figure 2b: medium cost c = 100, p = 0.5
Section 4, Figure 2a: with c = 50 the value is highest at p = 0.75

not_replicated.reason: The likelihood of the monitoring signal is a gamma distribution (bad state) and a four-parameter beta distribution (good state) fitted to total-nitrogen measurements of the Weser; neither the data ('available on request') nor the fitted parameters are published.
